body:
Good morning, Bakersfield. It’s Saturday, August 22, 2026, and we’re starting the day with a high of 103° and air quality at a moderate 67. Overnight, a shooting outside a Taco Bell in east Bakersfield was the most serious incident, with a suspect last seen in a white vehicle. Today’s top story is a fatal shooting at the Capri Laundromat in McFarland, where a 26-year-old man was killed in an altercation that spilled over from an adjacent liquor store. We’ll also cover the arrest of a 15-year-old suspect in connection with a deadly shooting at an Independence High School football game, and we’ll have details on a community flea market raising funds for a prosthetic leg. Let’s get you caught up.

## The Kern Overnight

The night’s most serious incident was a shooting reported just after midnight outside a Taco Bell in the Baker Street area. A witness told officers they saw someone shot, with the suspect described as a white male in his 40s to 50s, wearing a black shirt and dark pants, sitting inside a white vehicle — possibly a Ford Explorer. Officers responded with an officer-safety broadcast. Earlier, around 2:16 a.m., crews knocked down a fire at a vacant house on King Street, where flames were visible inside the single-story structure with heavy smoke showing. Multiple engines and a truck company responded, and the fire was under control by about 2:25. Just before 11 p.m., a two-vehicle collision near Gosford Road and Harris Road left one vehicle on fire; Engine 14 and Engine 9 responded, dubbing it the Harris Incident, though injuries were unknown. Also, a reported grass fire along southbound Highway 395 north of Brown Road drew a heavy response — engines, patrol units, a water tender, a dozer and a helicopter — but crews found a small roadside fire that was quickly extinguished, and the extra equipment was canceled.

## Today's weather

Expect a high near 103° and a low around 75° tonight. It’s currently 93° at Meadows Field (KBFL), and there are no active weather alerts for Kern County. Air quality is at a moderate 67, meaning it’s acceptable for most but sensitive groups should consider reducing prolonged or heavy outdoor exertion.

## Top stories

**23ABC reports that McFarland police are investigating a homicide after a 26-year-old man was shot and killed Saturday afternoon at the Capri Laundromat in the 100 block of Perkins Avenue.** Officers responded to the scene at approximately 3:18 p.m. and found the man suffering from multiple gunshot wounds inside the laundromat. Preliminary information indicates two unknown suspects arrived at the Capri Liquors in the 100 block of Perkins Avenue and confronted the victim inside the Capri Laundromat, which is adjacent to the gas pumps. An argument led to one of the suspects producing a firearm and shooting the victim multiple times. The two suspects then fled the area in an unknown vehicle. No suspects have been identified, no arrests have been made, and the motive remains unknown. The victim’s identity will be released after next of kin have been notified.

**KGET 17 tells us that a 15-year-old suspect has been arrested in connection with a deadly shooting at an Independence High School football game.** The arrest comes after gunshots rang out near the game, leaving nearby residents shaken. Bakersfield Police Sgt. Eric Celedon said Friday night football games are safe and acknowledged why some community members may be hesitant to attend future games, though the investigation is ongoing.

## Something good

A local family is organizing a flea market to support a community member in need of a prosthetic leg. The event aims to raise $8,900 for Villafana’s prosthetic leg and bring people together for a good cause.

## Coming up this week

On Wednesday, August 26, the city council will hold a special meeting at 12:00 p.m., followed by a city council meeting at 3:30 p.m. and another at 5:15 p.m. At the Fox Theater, Los Yonic’s Zamacona, Los caminantes, y Grupo Yndio will perform tonight, Saturday, August 22. On Tuesday, August 25, a Cults & Classics: Season Pass 2026-2027 event will be held, followed by Rodney Carrington on Thursday, August 27. CUMBIATRON: THE CUMBIA RAVE is set for Friday, August 28, and on Saturday, August 29, Willie Barcena and Michael Return Of The King Tribute Featuring Michael Phoenix will take the stage.
